text: 你看见：亚力克斯，管理者的夜巡队员。
source_text: 你看见：亚力克斯，管理者的夜巡队员。

text: 请进，
source_text: 请进，

text: 抱歉，我不能让你进来。早上再来吧。
source_text: 抱歉，我不能让你进来。早上再来吧。

text: 不许动！谁在那里？
source_text: 不许动！谁在那里？

text: 我只是一个旅行者。我想进来。
source_text: 我只是一个旅行者。我想进来。

text: 不关你事。
source_text: 不关你事。

text: 嗯，抱歉，我会离开。
source_text: 嗯，抱歉，我会离开。

text: 在市长的命令下，任何陌生人都不允许进入内城区。
source_text: 在市长的命令下，任何陌生人都不允许进入内城区。

text: 我只要个地方睡一晚而已。
source_text: 我只要个地方睡一晚而已。

text: 抱歉，我不能让你进来。转身离开，否则我要开枪了。
source_text: 抱歉，我不能让你进来。转身离开，否则我要开枪了。

text: 听着，我的职责就是光荣的作为一个夜巡队员为内城服务。所以这就关我事。转身离开，否则我就来真的了。
source_text: 听着，我的职责就是光荣的作为一个夜巡队员为内城服务。所以这就关我事。转身离开，否则我就来真的了。

text: 滚出我视线，约翰·洛。
source_text: 滚出我视线，约翰·洛。

text: 试试早上再来吧。
source_text: 试试早上再来吧。

text: 噢，够了。现在要动手了！
source_text: 噢，够了。现在要动手了！

text: 哼嗯。
source_text: 哼嗯。

text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see: 亚力克斯, the night watch 管理者.
source_text: You see: 亚力克斯, the night watch 管理者.

text: Come on in,
source_text: Come on in,

text: Sorry, I can't let you in. Come back in the morning.
source_text: Sorry, I can't let you in. Come back in the morning.

text: Halt! Who goes there?
source_text: Halt! Who goes there?

text: I'm just a traveler. I'd like to come inside.
source_text: I'm just a traveler. I'd like to come inside.

text: None of your business.
source_text: None of your business.

text: Um, sorry. I'll leave.
source_text: Um, sorry. I'll leave.

text: No strangers are allowed within the walls of Adytum, by order of the mayor.
source_text: No strangers are allowed within the walls of Adytum, by order of the mayor.

text: I just need a place to sleep for the night.
source_text: I just need a place to sleep for the night.

text: I'm sorry, but I can't let you in. Turn around and leave or I'll have to shoot.
source_text: I'm sorry, but I can't let you in. Turn around and leave or I'll have to shoot.

text: Look, it is my duty and my honor to serve as the night watch for Adytum, so it is my business. You turn around and leave, or I'll have to get serious.
source_text: Look, it is my duty and my honor to serve as the night watch for Adytum, so it is my business. You turn around and leave, or I'll have to get serious.

text: Get out of my face, 约翰.洛.
source_text: Get out of my face, 约翰.洛.

text: Try coming back in the morning.
source_text: Try coming back in the morning.

text: Oh, that's it. Now the gloves are off!
source_text: Oh, that's it. Now the gloves are off!

text: Nghgh.
source_text: Nghgh.
